usedFor: CalendarHero holds meeting requests, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when one changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A request turning into an event is a settled meeting, a clear moment to run your command.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd acts on your computers, so check the command is safe to run on every event.
